mission: Route work to providers by cost, performance, and availability to the right tier of agent without quality loss or work interruption regardless of session balance, token caps, funds, or provider outages.

waves.name: SR-W4
waves.goal: Deploy hygiene — enforce a HARD single-producer rule so the deploy can never drift. Infra-only, independent of the SR code chain; owns compose/release/Dockerfile (disjoint from every SR code ticket). NON-NEGOTIABLE: deploy docker-compose.yml has EXACTLY ONE producer (never both build: and image:). Only DECISION-GATED choice = WHICH single source (RECOMMENDED image-only/CI sole producer vs ALTERNATIVE build-only).

tickets.name: DEPLOY-HYGIENE
tickets.desc: HARD RULE: deploy docker-compose.yml has exactly ONE producer, never both build:+image: (no path to run a divergent build). DECISION-GATED which source (RECOMMENDED image-only, CI sole producer, immutable/digest-pinned tags / ALTERNATIVE build-only). Semver tags never :latest, release.yml publishes on tag push, bake CHARON_BUILD_SHA build-arg. depends_on none. RIDER: /charon/status SHA surfacing folds into SR-2 (proxy_server.py owner), NOT here.

waves.name: SR-W5
waves.goal: CI hygiene — mechanize GitHub Actions SHA-pin version bumps via Dependabot. Infra-only, independent of the SR code chain; owns a SINGLE NEW file (.github/dependabot.yml), disjoint from every SR code ticket, from SR-10 (compose/release/Dockerfile), and from CI1 (workflow files). Touches no workflow. Clears the Node-20 deprecations WITHOUT weakening the SHA-pin supply-chain posture (Dependabot bumps SHA->new SHA, never SHA->floating tag, and rewrites the # vX comment). github-actions ecosystem ONLY (docker/pip deliberately excluded). PR-only, no auto-merge.

tickets.name: DEPENDABOT-ACTIONS
tickets.desc: Add .github/dependabot.yml (github-actions ecosystem only; weekly, grouped, PR-only/no auto-merge) so SHA-pinned actions + their # vX comments stop going stale — clears Node-20 deprecations while preserving SHA-pinning (bump SHA->new SHA, rewrite comment). Excludes docker (Dockerfile base is a build-arg re-resolved fresh at release) + pip (open >= ranges, no lockfile => near-no-op). depends_on none. FOLLOW-ON (not here): optional actor-aware runs-on hardening owns .github/workflows/*.yml.

tickets.name: PROVIDER-ZEN
tickets.desc: Re-add opencode-zen preset (https://opencode.ai/zen/v1, key_env OPENCODE_ZEN_KEY) so configs stop crash-looping with 'unknown provider opencode-zen' + needing a base_url band-aid; keep opencode-go alongside. OPTIONAL: neuralwatt preset (operator-decides). depends_on SR-5 (real-dep: shared single-owner file providers.py). tier economy.

waves.name: SR-W7
waves.goal: Consumption half of SR-5 — multiply captured per-token pricing by actual tokens so usage.cost_usd stops reading 0 for providers that don't echo a cost, and feed the SAME computed cost to the spend-limiter pre-flight estimate + record. Money-path math. Sole new proxy.py+proxy_server.py owner after the SR-2 -> SR-6 -> SR-7 -> SR-8 -> TIER-SELECT chain; owns only the spend-limiter CALL SITES in proxy_server.py, never spend_limits.py (SR-7).

tickets.name: COST-WIRE
tickets.desc: When the provider reports NO cost, compute cost_usd = tokens_in*cost_input + tokens_out*cost_output from SR-5's stored pricing (coordinate the canonical unit with SR-5); use the same computed cost in the proxy_server.py pre-flight estimate (~:657, was hardcoded) + spend_limiter.record (~:777, was the provider number). Distinguish unknown/unpriced (0+flag) from priced-at-0. depends_on SR-5 (real-dep: build — pricing must be captured first), SR-2 + TIER-SELECT (real-dep: single-owner file proxy_server.py). tier strong.

waves.name: SR-W8

New CHARON_SESSION_KEY secret (auto-generated, decoupled from the gateway token). Stdlib-only. Sequences AFTER the whole SR proxy_server.py chain + SR-5b; scoped to proxy_server.py + cli.py (secrets.py/gateway.py touchpoints coordinated as a follow-on).

tickets.desc: Add /charon/login page (paste token into a form once, not the URL) + `charon login` CLI printing a click-once pre-authed URL + a 30-day HMAC-signed HttpOnly charon_sess cookie authorizing /charon/* ONLY. /v1/* Bearer auth unchanged (opencode/ACP/LAN clients unaffected). CHARON_SESSION_KEY in secrets.json, decoupled from the gateway token. Surface-aware dispatch refactor of the single auth gate. depends_on SR-2 + SR-5b (real-dep: single-owner file proxy_server.py) + pending token->secrets.json rotation. tier strong.

Proactive free-tier quota tracking (TOP), chat playground, finish image-aware routing, inline limit editor, opt-in extractive context compaction. proxy_server.py is a SINGLE-WRITER bottleneck: RFL-1->RFL-3->RFL-2->RFL-4 form a strict linear chain AFTER the current tail SR-13; RFL-5 owns a NEW module only (disjoint, parallel). Model routing: DeepSeek V4-Pro (strong) for the mechanical/well-specced units; Claude Opus 4.8 (frontier) reserved for RFL-5 (breaks the transparent-proxy invariant, mutates user content, must be gated). Stdlib-only; all features additive/backward-compatible; RFL-5 OFF by default.

New src/charon/quota.py + failover call site in proxy_server.py. depends_on SR-13 (real-dep: single-owner proxy_server.py). Agent: DeepSeek V4-Pro (strong). Effort M.

Agent: Claude Opus 4.8 (frontier) — the one design-heavy/tricky pick. Effort M/L.
